edbDesc: A specific kind of Doppler effect, which occurs when an intensity modulated light wave induces a photoacoustic wave on moving particles with a specific frequency. The observed frequency shift is a good indicator of the velocity of the illuminated moving particles. A potential biomedical application is measuring blood flow.
title: Photoacoustic Doppler Effect
pickWhy: The photoacoustic effect combined with the Doppler shift on moving particles, a measuring technique rather than a new effect; folded into Photoacoustic effect.
